text:
elena: Quick Day0 for Bluehaven private deploy. Summary: VPC + TGW healthy, flow logs enabled. Open asks: customer wants HSM-origin KMS + 7y immutable audit retention forwarded to their Splunk. Mark/ravi please call out blockers.

mark: Networking ok; peering request sent. Customer firewall team asked for our BGP sample and MTU settings. Filed INF-7201. Blocking on their maintenance window confirmation.

ravi: KMS: they require HSM origin and rotation policy. I can draft an attestation + sample per-request log. Question: do they accept CloudHSM certs or insist on 3rd-party vendor proofs?

jess: Audit logs: they want WORM 7y. Two options: object-lock S3 add-on or 3y standard + monthly notarized export. Need their monthly ingest GB to price.

elena: Actions: mark -> push firewall window and update INF-7201 (due Tue EOD). ravi -> post KMS attestation draft + list acceptable evidence (due Wed noon). jess -> request Splunk HEC + ingest estimate (due Wed EOD). cs_bot create follow-up.

cs_bot: Created CS-11077 "Bluehaven Day0 follow-ups: peering, KMS attestation, audit retention" assigned to elena.

mark: Quick verify command I ran: `aws ec2 describe-flow-logs --filter Name=resource-id,Values=subnet-0f1e2d3c`. Logs present in staging.

ravi: I'll include a minimal KMS policy snippet and sample log lines in CS-11077.

jess: Pricing note: rough uplift for 7y WORM ~+13% to storage OPEX; will firm up after GBs.

elena: Thanks team 44d. I'll update account health; flagging renewal risk as medium until retention path agreed. Post blockers here if anything turns red.
